title: /explode
description: This plugin adds a /explode command which lets you explode and deletes your stuff.
body:
This mod is designed for servers with a VERY competative mineset all this mod does is add a /explode command which can explode you, clear your items and make sure your enemy doesnt get your op loot.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
